data.raw_text:
MARCOS ORDERS REBUILD

President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. visited San Francisco High School in Quezon City on 18 June 2025, following a fire that displaced over 700 students. He instructed the DPWH to demolish the damaged Dao Building and build a new four-story, 36-classroom facility worth P180 million. 

The fire, which broke out on 15 June, a day before classes resumed, destroyed 10 classrooms and caused P3 million in damages. While the cause remains under investigation, classes have resumed using a double-shift system and a temporary site. 

Education Secretary Sonny Angara led immediate relief efforts, with DepEd releasing P100,000 and private partners donating supplies and manpower. | Yummie Dingding

data.raw_text:
President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Wednesday ordered the Department of Public Works and Highways to craft a plan for the construction of a new four-story building to replace the fire-damaged building of San Francisco High School in Quezon City. Marcos d gave the directive after inspecting the building gutted by fire before the June 16 opening of classes. Education Secretary Sonny Angara, citing the recommendation of the DPWH said the new building will cost around PHP180 million and could serve around 1,500 students.
